Class ExprNode

java.lang.Object
threepl.nodes.Node
threepl.nodes.ExprNode
All Implemented Interfaces:
TDEConstants, Constant
public final class ExprNode extends Node implements Constant, TDEConstants
This class represents an operator code tree node. It handles all operators except the unary operators ++, --, * and ? which are implemented as flags or codes in the VarNode (variable node). -> is not treated as an operator but rather a separator between subscript/field tokens.

  • Method Details

    • getVal

      public Val getVal()
      Get the value from an expression operator. For immediate arguments a single constant Val is returned. If one or more arguments are target variables or expressions containing target variables, a TDEVar Val will be returned.

      There are two cases where type conversion occurs -

      1. The '+' operator will accept string operands, performing concatenation. If one operand is an int, uint or log it will be converted to a string
      2. Arithmetic binary operators accept mixed int-uint pairs, converting the uint to int. For target operands the int-uint type mixing is handled by the low-level code generator.

      For immediate operands int and uint are treated the same, the immediate uint being implemented as a long but restricted to 63 bits so that it is always positive as signed 64bit.

      For target operands the types are passed through to the TDE and then on to the low level code generator. Allowed types (and mixtures of types) must be handled there.

      The width of an arithmetic operation is such as to maintain precision in the result. This may be truncated on later assignment.
